loops.minute_1: Click cookie for 1 cookie. Discover first building (Cursor). Early manual clicking dominates.
loops.minute_10: Own 3-5 buildings generating 5-20 CpS passively. Buildings cost-scale exponentially (~15% increase per unit). Manual clicks are now negligible vs. autogen.
loops.hour_5: Dozens of buildings active. Prestige system visible (heavenly chips reward resetting for +1% permanent CpS). Golden cookies appear (temporary 7% boost, 30-60s intervals). Wrinklers drain production but offer interest payouts.
loops.endgame: Prestige layers: hundreds of levels possible but cube-root scaling makes each level harder. Prestige becomes the meta-goal. Multiple achievement tracks (637 total) provide secondary objectives. No hard ending; players define personal win conditions.

objectives.player_goal: Maximize prestige level, accumulate cookies to astronomical numbers, discover all 637 achievements, pursue personal goals (e.g., 'reach 1 undecillion cookies')

games.retention_answer: Exponential growth satisfaction + frequent small rewards (golden cookies every 30-60s) + prestige restart cycles (soft resets) + achievement board structure + numerical escalation fantasy (1 → 1 trillion). Players return to experience compounding growth from prestige bonuses and explore new upgrade/feature combinations.

loops.minute_1: Gather catnip manually (0.1 catnip/click). Discover catnip fields unlock, beginning passive generation.
loops.minute_10: Catnip fields autogenerate. Wood becomes available (requires harvesting). First storage cap encountered: must build barns to hold more catnip. Food constraint emerges: kittens consume catnip.
loops.hour_5: Multiple resource chains active (catnip → wood → minerals → steel). Trading mechanics unlock (commerce requiring merchant ships). Prestige/reset system visible (paragon resets grant karma if kitten population ≥35). Metaphysics upgrades purchasable with accumulated paragon.
loops.endgame: Space/discovery phases unlock (soft ending). Technology tree cascades (50+ techs, each enabling 3-5 new features). Civilization phases (time travel, astrophysics) become available. Karma prestige cycles reward long-term engagement across multiple resets.

objectives.victory_condition: Reach space exploration phase (soft ending). Discover all civilization phases. Achieve maximum karma level.
objectives.player_goal: Manage resource chains to unlock technology tiers. Optimize prestige timing to maximize karma. Balance production vs. storage to progress without stalling. Unlock and explore all game phases.

games.retention_answer: Storage puzzle engagement (players solve 'build more barns or throttle production?') + discovery-based progression (each technology unlock feels like world expansion) + multi-phase prestige (karma system encourages repeat playthroughs with increasing efficiency) + offline accumulation (resources continue growing during absence). Players return to optimize prestige cycles and discover new civilization phases.

loops.minute_1: Click monster for 1 damage. Monster defeated, gold earned. First hero (Cid) purchased. Damage now passive and multiplied.
loops.minute_10: 5-10 heroes hired (Cid 3×, Warrior 5×, Archer 10×, etc.). Damage multiplies. Monster chains defeat rapidly. Gold income accelerates. Early upgrades visible.
loops.hour_5: Ascension (prestige) becomes attractive: sacrifice all progress for hero souls (permanent DPS multiplier, 10% each). Ancients (permanent upgrades purchased with hero souls) are active (e.g., Atman multiplies gold, Siyalatas boosts idle DPS). Idle detection: after 60s no clicks, damage doubles.
loops.endgame: Transcension (second prestige currency, ancient souls) unlocks. Ascended skills enable stacking bonuses (some heroes grant +click damage, others stack for multiplicative gain). Optimal ascension timing becomes a strategic math problem (balance monster progression vs. soul farming).

objectives.player_goal: Defeat monsters in sequence (1 → 2 → 3 → ...). Ascend at optimal times to maximize hero souls. Acquire and level ancients strategically. Maximize idle DPS. Reach transcension and unlock ascended skills.

games.retention_answer: Satisfying click feedback + monster defeat animations + idle automation (passive income rewards AFK play) + multiple prestige currencies (hero souls / ancient souls) enabling nested progression + hero acquisition and leveling providing frequent micro-rewards. Players return to optimize ascension timing and watch exponential DPS growth from ancients.

loops.minute_1: Click to make 1 paperclip. Purchase clipper machine. Passive generation begins.
loops.minute_10: Multiple production chains (wire → clips, clips → paperclips). Raw wire purchased from suppliers. First stage (bureaucratic paperclip production) feels complete.
loops.hour_5: Marketing strategy unlocks (reputation multiplies clip sales). Processor power becomes a resource (computational cycles purchase upgrades). Hazard remediation introduced (protect probe swarms from black holes). Aware the game has stages beyond production.
loops.endgame: Stage 3/4 transition: space probes launched, von Neumann replication begins. Hazard combat systems active (spending to defend swarms). Final choice: accept proposal (restart with artifacts, prestige-like system) or reject (game ends with existential narrative). Both paths are designed endings.

objectives.victory_condition: Reach stage 4 final choice. Select accept (prestige restart) or reject (permanent ending with narrative closure).
objectives.player_goal: Advance through production stages (manual → machinery → marketing → processor → space). Manage hazard/combat resource sinks. Make final choice (accept or reject proposal), triggering story ending.

games.retention_answer: Narrative progression + stage-gated gameplay (each stage feels like a new game within the game, preventing repetition fatigue) + existential/strategic tension (hazard combat implies real consequences) + branching ending choice (player agency in final decision). Players return to experience each stage and explore consequences of accept/reject decision. Unlike other incrementals, the hard ending prevents infinite play, making each run feel purposeful.
